decisions.decision: Fix org-creation blocker via SECURITY DEFINER RPC create_organization_onboarding + search_path=public + restored base grants
decisions.rationale: Root cause G-02-1R2: missing base grants blocked RLS evaluation; RPC makes atomic org+membership+subscription creation possible

decisions.decision: Use service-role admin client to set JWT app_metadata claims + refresh session after onboarding
decisions.rationale: RLS policies read claims that anon-key updates cannot set; stale session token would keep reading old claims

decisions.decision: Public auth/landing paths short-circuit before handleI18nRouting in middleware
decisions.rationale: localePrefix 'always' rewrote unprefixed /login -> /en/login which 404'd; public paths must bypass i18n redirect

decisions.decision: Remove <html>/<body> from [locale]/layout.tsx; root layout owns document elements
decisions.rationale: Nested document elements broke hydration + RSC navigation (G-02-1R)

decisions.decision: Replace BottomNav useState(() => loadRole()) effect hack with useEffect + cancellation flag; fix dashboard 'Dodaj tim' CTA actionHref='#' -> /{locale}/teams
decisions.rationale: RETEST #4 fixes: async setNavItems could update after unmount; broken CTA did nothing
